# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU backend preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, built on Skia m152. Adds a new async pixel-readback API, several memory-leak and performance fixes, a Vulkan/Silk.NET package, and FreeType-based font support on Nano Server.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia Chrome milestone m152** — Bundles the Skia m152 engine, including merged chrome/m151 and m152 upstream bug fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings (preview)** — Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels for asynchronous, backend-neutral pixel access. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — Adds a Silk.NET-based Vulkan interop package, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes** — SKRegion.SpanIterator, SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, and the SKImage raster-create failure path now correctly root or free native memory instead of leaving dangling pointers. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Reflection and allocation micro-fixes** — Caches a skip-registration reflection check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, pre-sizes a uniform lookup map, and avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server now uses FreeType for font rendering, since the platform lacks the usual system font APIs. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test legs added** — Adds Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server containerized CI test legs for broader platform coverage. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Converts the HarfBuzzSharp solution to .slnx and adds the new containerized test legs alongside the SkiaSharp infra changes.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces the Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, the Vulkan/Silk.NET package, several native use-after-free and performance fixes, and updates the engine to Skia m152.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.1...v4.152.0-preview.1.1)
